title: Enable best-effort background live location sharing (no need to keep the app open)

requirements.text: Implement best-effort background live location sharing so that, after a child enables live location sharing, location updates can continue even when the app is not in the foreground (and, where the platform supports it, even after the tab/app UI is closed).

quotes: ajuste para que o app não necessite estar aberto para o compartilhamento em tempo real, mas que trabalhe em segundo plano.

acceptanceCriteria: When a child enables Live Location Sharing, the app continues attempting periodic location updates while the page is backgrounded (e.g., another tab/app is in front) without requiring the user to keep the page focused.
If the platform/browser does not support continuing execution after the app is closed, the UI communicates that limitation clearly (i.e., no misleading promise of always-on background sharing).

Live Location Sharing state remains controlled by the backend flag (useGetLiveLocationSharingStatus / useSetLiveLocationSharing) and is not silently toggled off just because a capture attempt failed locally.

requirements.text: Add PWA support (web app manifest + service worker registration) and attempt periodic/background sync approaches where available, to continue submitting location updates when the UI is closed, while keeping behavior safe and permission-respecting.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend includes an installable PWA manifest and registers a service worker from the React app entry flow (without modifying any immutable paths).

Where supported by the browser, the app uses a background-capable mechanism (e.g., service worker + background/periodic sync) to queue and/or submit location updates when Live Location Sharing is enabled.
On browsers that do not support background/periodic sync, the app falls back to foreground/background-tab operation only and shows a clear status/notice.

requirements.text: Update all user-facing copy and transparency/consent messaging to accurately reflect the new background behavior, including the transparency policy section that currently states the app does not collect data in the background.

quotes: ...não necessite estar aberto... trabalhe em segundo plano.

acceptanceCriteria: English translations are updated for Live Location Sharing helper text so it no longer claims sharing only works while the app is open (e.g., update liveLocationActiveInfo, liveLocationForegroundNote, and parent-side live sharing description).
Portuguese (pt-BR) translations are updated to match the new meaning.
The Transparency & Policies content is updated so it does not incorrectly state the app 'Does NOT collect data in the background' when background live sharing is enabled by the child.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Respect browser privacy/permission requirements: do not attempt background location collection without explicit child opt-in via the existing Live Location Sharing toggle.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Adding push notifications or any server-initiated real-time delivery mechanism.
Guaranteeing background location sharing on all browsers/devices even when the app is fully closed (implement best-effort and communicate platform limitations).
Introducing third-party authentication, native mobile builds, or external background location SDKs.
